summary: DTE Electric Co. and its consolidated special-purpose subsidiary, DTE Electric Securitization Funding III LLC, filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated November 3, 2026 with Citigroup Global Markets Inc., as representative of the underwriters, to issue and sell $600,461,000 of Senior Secured Securitization Bonds, Series 2026A. The bonds will be issued under an indenture and series supplement dated November 12, 2026, offered via a same-day prospectus. Ancillary servicing, purchase and sale, administration and intercreditor agreements are expected. This is a routine structured bond financing, not a special situation.
